about: The texturing doctrine (Mateo, 2026-11-11): region > colour family with a code > a ladder of blocks. Edit this file, then run build_doctrine.py to rebuild the region pages and the viewer.

rules.big_surface: walls longer than 15 or taller than 9, and civic buildings
rules.ladder_order: dark to light by value unless 'order' says otherwise
rules.no_skipped_steps: neighbouring cells differ by at most one ladder step
rules.clusters: walls: edges interlocking in columns (paint_teeth, Mateo's examples); roofs and ground: soft clusters; never single-block speckle
rules.cracks: corners, openings, where planes meet; darkest part of the gradient
rules.walls: vertical surfaces use paint_teeth: bands bottom to top, edges interlocking in columns 1 to 2 rows deep, a few lone blocks ahead of each edge
rules.texture_along_ladder: texture may change along a ladder (bricks low, cobble, then smoother stone up top) as long as lightness climbs; colour may shift only across a real material change (stone to earth)
rules.ladder_check: every ladder climbs in lightness with no two neighbours within about 5 of each other (equal-lightness pairs read as noise, not gradient); rough textures low, smooth high
